segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: Muse AI agent lands in Instagram DMs
segments.point: Plus a Walmart Black Friday tie-up
segments.narration: Meta's Muse AI agent now lives in Instagram DMs.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Walmart partners with Meta on Muse
segments.narration: Walmart partnered with Meta, so customers can shop its Black Friday deals through Muse.

segments.label: THE NUMBERS
segments.title: Muse: 51% of AI-agent orders
segments.narration: Muse had fifty-one percent of AI-agent shopping orders, per Forter Intelligence. Not all online orders.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: Shopping meets chat, with a catch
segments.narration: Customers may shop where they chat. The catch: Amazon blocked Muse in September, and no deal is announced.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Watch it, don't rebuild yet
segments.narration: Our take: Don't rebuild around Muse yet. Keep product details clear and watch the Amazon talks.
